notes.NON_COURT: Never contributes court inventory. A bookable PBP resource that is not a court.
notes.ALTERNATE: A court-hire surface that re-exposes courts already counted under a COURT surface, through a different booking/entitlement channel. Never contributes capacity. Relevant at checkout, not at discovery.
notes.UNKNOWN: Not a stored class. What classify() returns for a surface absent from this file. Contributes nothing and must be reviewed.

championship_courts.evidence: Dink & Drive; 'Championship Court 7/8'. Priced separately ($59.09 vs $50)

members_only.evidence: The Rally: 6 resources 18043-18049 named 'Court 1 Overlap'..'Court 6 Overlap', ids disjoint from indoor_pickleball 16078-16093, is_parent=false where ordinary courts are is_parent=true. Pickleplex: 4 resources 15966-16071 named 'Court 1 '..'Court 4 ' against indoor_pickleball 14833-14836. Confirmed at The Rally as a selectable court type at booking, not separate capacity.
members_only.consequence: Discovery must materialise each physical court ONCE, from its COURT surface. Showing 'Court 1' and 'Court 1 Overlap' side by side would present one physical court as two bookable units.
members_only.open_pairing: No link field exists between the two id sets -- the probe checked every field. Pairing is currently only inferable from names ('Court 1 Overlap' -> 'Court 1 - Show Court'; Pickleplex 'Court 1 ' with a trailing space -> 'Court 1'), which is the name-based identity 2A removed. A checkout that must book the members_only representation needs a reliable mapping first.
members_only.open_purpose: What it grants is NOT established. Member pricing already resolves on the public surface: pricing ordinary court 16078 at The Rally returned affiliation 'V2 - Rally Member' at $25 without touching members_only. So it is probably member-only access windows or free-hour entitlement rather than pricing. Do not build checkout on the assumption that member pricing requires it.

census.note: Baseline from the unfiltered estate census, 2026-08-19, 21 surfaces across 21 active venues. A surface appearing outside this list on a later cycle is UNKNOWN and must be reviewed before it can contribute inventory.

invariant: One physical court contributes one unit of inventory regardless of how many PBP surfaces expose it.
